lines.en: I pace slowly through the conifer wood.

lines.zh: 我的大身子压得草伏下。
lines.en: My bulk presses the grass down.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面都闷响。
lines.en: Each step makes a muffled thump.
I angle past a birch.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑森林的树线走。
lines.en: I walk the dark forest's treeline.
A pumpkin lantern glows in my chest.

lines.zh: 灯在胸口晃，我走得很稳。
lines.en: My chest lamp sways; my steps stay steady.
I move toward my anchor.
My steps are steady and heavy.
I cross a patch of fallen leaves.
I stop and level my breathing.
I shift my heavy foot once more.
I stand like a round tower.
A faint glow shows through my body.
I listen quietly to the distance.
I move my heavy arm slowly.

lines.zh: 林子在我身边显得很矮。
lines.en: The wood seems low beside me.

lines.zh: 手掌很宽，能盖住一丛草。
lines.en: My palm is wide enough to cover a clump of grass.
Wind passes through my pumpkin shell.
No hurry; I'm slower than anyone.
The wind goes around my bulk.

lines.zh: 我把重量压在一只脚上。
lines.en: I rest my weight on one foot.
I stand, my chest lamp pulsing.
I raise my eyes to the treetops.
I'm very quiet now.
I close one fist slowly.
I look down at you; you're small.
Would you take me along?
I crouch slowly to your eye level.

lines.zh: 你得仰着头才看得见我。
lines.en: You have to crane up to see me.
I reach out only to signal.
There's no face beneath my mask.
You called my name; I heard.
I nod once as an answer.
I turn my lamp toward you.
You look up into my lamp.
I'll guard you.
You go ahead; I cover the rear.
I lower my hand to show you.
A lamp burns inside this pumpkin shell.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像活人，不是数据。
lines.en: You smell of flesh, not data.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳底下，我一直在看。
lines.en: Under the pumpkin, I've been watching.
My shell rang once.
That made my shell boom.
A hit on my shell. No matter.
I don't fall easily.
I sat back and squashed the pumpkin.
This crack is nothing to mention.
I've weighed your strength.
My lamp swings but still burns.
I can still block.
Let us continue.
This little thing, for me?
I crouch slowly to take it.
This smell is strong.
I lift it carefully.
It is very small in my hand.

lines.zh: 我这大身子压得草伏下，尝一小口。
lines.en: This bulk of mine flattens the grass; I take one small taste.
This pumpkin's hollow — still not enough.
My hands are big; set it lower.
Half the pumpkin shell is empty.
Not bad; thank you.
That much won't fill this pumpkin.
A little more; I crouch and wait.
My round belly bounces you off.
I turn slowly aside.
I stand there, not shifting an inch.
You're bounced backwards.
We scatter the fallen leaves.
I move my foot to make room.
I steady myself and don't fall.

lines.zh: 这点力道连壳都没震动。
lines.en: That force didn't even rattle my shell.
I settle my feet again.
I turn aside and open a path.

lines.zh: 另一个高大的身影过来。
lines.en: Another tall shape comes over.

lines.zh: 我们的身体几乎一样宽。
lines.en: We're nearly the same width.
We stand side by side in the wood.
Its lamp glows brighter than mine.
The pumpkin head still glows.
Both our breathing is slow.
Wind passes between us.
In this moment the wood is quiet.
Tomorrow we swap patrols.
We don't wander far.
I bend and pick it up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰把它捡起，它在我手里很小。
lines.en: I stoop and pick it up; it is tiny in my hand.
I tuck it against my chest.
It's too light for my grip.
I hold it under my lamp.

lines.zh: 这东西，我收进壳的夹层。
lines.en: I stow this in a gap in my shell.
I set it down gently, afraid to crush it.
I can carry this much.
Holding it in both hands, I bend down.
I straighten up again.
The trees there shook.

lines.zh: 那边的东西我注意到了。
lines.en: I've noticed that thing there.
I heave up out of my crouch.
I see the shape in the tree shadow.
I stride over that way.
I lift my first foot.
My great hand rises slowly.
I've readied my move.
It's a few steps off.
Fine, I pick that one.
I lower myself into a slope.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，很沉，面具已戴上。
lines.en: One heavy cry; my mask is on.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下被压成泥。
lines.en: Leaves pulp under my feet.
I'm blocking its path.

lines.zh: 我靠近得很慢，但是在靠近。
lines.en: I close slowly, but I close.
My shadow covers the ground first.
It turns, and I halt.

lines.zh: 我这颗南瓜头，里面点着灯。
lines.en: A lamp burns inside this pumpkin head.
It's backed to a tree.
I shift half a step nearer.
This distance will do.
No rush; I am heavy.
The chance is now.
I raise my leg.

lines.zh: 我这一下，砸在它肩甲上。
lines.en: This blow lands on its shoulder guard.
The ground dents where I strike.
I drive half my armored shoulder in.
It's shoved back several steps.
Fallen leaves swirl up.
I lift it clear off the ground.
I follow with another fist.
I withdraw and steady.
I press it to the ground.
It drops to the ground; I step back.
I return to your side.
I pull my fist back and step off.
I come out from the treeline.
Beyond the treeline, the light dims.
Pumpmon, standing here.

lines.zh: 我落地时，树叶都跳起来。
lines.en: As I land, the leaves jump.
I straighten up to the treetops.
My lamp glows in the dim light.
I come from the birch wood.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看这片林子。
lines.en: I look down at this wood.
My data is steady.
I crouch slowly to wait for you.
My foot snaps a dry branch.
I come over from the dark forest edge.

lines.zh: 火焰烧着我的外壳，很烫。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell, painfully hot.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，砸出一个深坑。
lines.en: Falling from high, I crater the ground.
Water fills my body; I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得滑开一段。
lines.en: The blast skids me a distance.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物打在我的肩上。
lines.en: A projectile hits my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力穿进我的数据里。
lines.en: The force passes into my data.
My data is dropping.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，灯闪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my lamp flickers.

lines.zh: 脚下没锚点，我沉不下去。
lines.en: No anchor here; I can't settle.
